title: Navigation and prefetch: Keep navigation internal and explicit; use next/link for user navigation and do not turn untrusted destinations into open redirects
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for navigation and prefetch. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: Keep navigation internal and explicit; use next/link for user navigation and do not turn untrusted destinations into open redirects.
Repair the intentionally failing next-navigation-prefetch model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain navigation and prefetch in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.06 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.

sources.label: Next.js reference for Navigation and prefetch
